definition: to make certain that something is safe
description: At the foot of a tall pale limestone cliff with orange streaks, under a deep blue sky, a young man in a blue T-shirt and climbing harness kneels on a red mat and checks the knot where an orange rope is tied into the harness of a young woman. She wears a green sports top, black leggings and a harness hung with metal clips, smiles down at him with her hands together, then rubs her hands and gets ready to climb. A coil of rope, a water bottle, shoes and spiky agave plants lie around them.
